headword: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け
gloss: for beginners; aimed at beginner learners

definitions.gloss: for beginners; intended for beginner learners; entry-level
definitions.explanation: Designed for or aimed at beginners — people who are just starting to learn a skill or subject. Seen as a label on textbooks, classes, apps, tutorials, and equipment. Contrasted with {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}け (for advanced users).

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けです。
examples.english: This app is aimed at beginners.

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{挫折|ざせつ}→挫折：08992_zasetsu⟧しにくい。
examples.english: Starting with a book for beginners makes it less likely you'll give up.

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{物足|ものた}りなく→物足りない：06627_monotarinai⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Beginner-level explanations are thorough, but once you get used to it you may find them lacking.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{初級者|しょきゅうしゃ}→初級者：29204_shokyuusha⟧ (beginner, elementary learner) and the suffix ～{向|む}け (aimed at, intended for, targeted at). The suffix ～{向|む}け attaches to a noun referring to a group of people and forms a noun or modifier meaning "intended for [that group]."

USAGE:
- As a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧ (a beginner-level class)
- As a predicate: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けです (This book is for beginners)
- Common on language textbooks, music tutorials, cooking recipes, fitness programs, and game difficulty labels

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}: a book for beginners
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: a beginner course
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: a beginner-friendly explanation
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧: written for beginners

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}け→上級者向け：23686_joukyuushamuke⟧: for advanced users — the direct antonym
- {中級者向|ちゅうきゅうしゃむ}け: for intermediate learners — the middle level
- ⟦{初心者向|しょしんしゃむ}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧: for newcomers / complete beginners — a near-synonym; ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧ nuances someone with no experience at all
- ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧: introduction, entry — used as a prefix in titles, e.g., ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}{書|しょ}→入門書：18849_nyuumonsho⟧ (introductory book)
